tasks.short: Establish behavior policies and enforce rules among students.

steps.what: Establish behavior policies and procedures for this class.
Enforce behavior rules among students to maintain order.

tasks.design: She writes the behavior policies and procedures for this class, then enforces those rules among the students in the room. Order depends on the pupils present, so both steps stay with her. No tool is added.
tasks.previous_blocker: Order depends on what the pupils do in the room, which a stored rule cannot see.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new removes that. The policies can sit in a document she already keeps.
tasks.still_hard: She still has to judge the moment and keep order among students.
tasks.human_edge: She sees the class and decides when a rule applies.
tasks.altitude: Her week does not change. She still sets the behavior policies and enforces them in the room.

reach.task: Confirm the behavior policies this class will use.
reach.learn: Which behavior rules the school already set for secondary special education.

evidence.claim: Establishing behavior policies and enforcing them among students stays with the teacher, because it depends on the pupils in the room.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: this task is the written behavior policies and the in-room enforcement. It does not cover student records, educational plans, or classroom strategies.
The behavior policies are a document she writes. There is no structured field list and no tool to keep.
Upkeep is zero because no tool is added.
Talking with students in the room is a write inside the organisation. It does not send anything outside the organisation.
unknowns: Whether the school already has written behavior policies for this class.
research_questions: Which behavior rules does this secondary special-education class already use?

incremental.description: No tool is added, so there is no upkeep.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Both steps stay as they are. A week with the same class still takes the full time, because no tool is added.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Keep student records and prepare required reports on children and activities.

steps.what: Note the activities these children did during the lesson.
Maintain accurate and complete student records with the activity and the mark.
Decide the reports required by laws, district policies and administrative regulations.
Prepare report draft v1 from the stored pupil, activity, mark and date.
Check report draft v1 and reject any claim the student record does not state.
File the checked draft as the required reports in the pupil record.

tasks.design: She watches the children and writes the activity and the mark in the pupil administration ({OTHER}). A draft step copies the stored pupil, activity, mark and date into report draft v1; she checks that the draft says only what the student record says; a separate release step files that checked version as the required reports. The draft does not score a pupil, does not add a sentence, and does not mail anyone.
tasks.previous_blocker: The report was retyped from the pupil record because the pupil administration had no query over pupil, activity, mark and date.
tasks.enabler_now: Those four fields are already stored, so a configured query can copy them into report draft v1.
tasks.still_hard: She still has to check that the draft says only what the student record says, and a missing field stops the draft.
tasks.human_edge: She knows whether the activity and the mark are a fair account of the children.
tasks.altitude: She still notes the lesson and enters the activity and the mark. She no longer retypes those stored fields into the required reports, and she still checks the draft before it is filed.

reach.task: State which activity fields a progress report must contain.
reach.learn: Which of pupil, activity, mark and date the pupil administration already stores.

evidence.claim: A required report can be a query of fields the teacher already stored. Copying pupil, activity, mark and date does not need a model.
ParnasSys keeps pupil records, an OPP module and learning-goal tracking, and the source names no AI.
AI that evaluates learning outcomes is high-risk from 2 December 2027.
Rescoring requests rose from 2,758 in 2024 to 64,489 in 2026, and computers first scored 58 percent of more than 13,300 raised reading scores.
Under the WMS, staff consent to tools that can monitor them, and parents and pupils consent to pupil-data rules.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: this task is the lesson note, the student record, the choice of required reports, report draft v1, the check, and the filing. It does not cover behavior rules, the educational plan, or classroom instruction.

Fields are pupil, activity, mark and date. The special education teacher stores them in the pupil administration ({OTHER}) while she maintains the student record. If any field is empty, the draft does not run and she writes that part by hand.

The draft step is not gated. It adds no sentence, score or label. The check reads report draft v1 after it exists. The release files that same version and does not write a new one. A later edit voids the check.
The release is a write inside the organisation. It does not mail parents or anyone outside the school.
Copying stored fields is not an evaluation of learning outcomes, and this draft does not score a pupil. The Texas rescoring case is why the draft does not score.
Existing pupil-administration runtime is not her effort. Upkeep of 0.5 hours per 100 hours of this task is the field-list check and is not already inside a step.
Access still needs the school's pupil-data consent. This copy does not monitor staff.
Shares follow today's means: the lesson in the room is 29, record entry is 15, deciding the required reports is 36, the copy a query replaces is 9, the check is 8, and the filing is 3.
unknowns: Whether this pupil administration already has a report query over pupil, activity, mark and date.
Whether the district requires a sentence that is not one of those four fields.
research_questions: Which administrative regulations name the fields the required reports must contain?

already_counted.description: She checks report draft v1 and rejects a claim the student record does not state.

incremental.description: Check that pupil, activity, mark and date are still the fields the required reports use.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low is a week where the query does not run because a field is empty, while the 0.5 hour field-list check still happens. High is a week where most reports are complete stored fields and a few need a sentence she writes by hand.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Confer with parents and professionals and develop educational plans.

steps.what: Confer with parents, administrators, testing specialists, social workers and other professionals.
Develop individual educational plans for students' physical and social development.

tasks.design: She confers with the parents, administrators, testing specialists, social workers and other professionals, then develops the individual educational plans for the students' physical and social development. The plan is agreed in that meeting, so both steps stay with her. No tool is added.
tasks.previous_blocker: The plan is agreed in the meeting, and a project that would draft the justification has published no results.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new writes the plan for her. The meeting stays the place the plan is developed.
tasks.still_hard: Parents, administrators and other professionals still have to agree the educational plans.
tasks.human_edge: She holds the conversation about the students' physical and social development.
tasks.altitude: Her week does not change. She still meets the parents and the other professionals and writes the educational plans with them.

reach.task: Name the parts an individual educational plan must contain.
reach.learn: Which plan fields the meeting must agree before she writes it.

evidence.claim: AI that sets the education level or evaluates learning outcomes is high-risk.
A project intends to draft plan justifications against quality criteria and has published no results.
The educational plans are developed in the meeting with the parents and the other professionals.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: this task is the meeting and the educational plans written from it. It does not file the plan, draft it with a machine, or cover behavior rules, reports, or classroom instruction.
The meeting notes are what she writes during the conference. There is no structured field list and no tool to keep.
Upkeep is zero because no tool is added.
Talking with parents and colleagues in the meeting is a write inside the organisation. It does not send anything outside the organisation.
unknowns: Whether the district requires the educational plan to be stored after the meeting.
research_questions: Which parts of the educational plan must be agreed in the meeting?

incremental.description: No tool is added, so there is no upkeep.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The conference and the plan stay as they are. A week with the same meetings still takes the full time, because no tool is added.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Use special educational strategies and techniques during instruction.

steps.what: Choose special educational strategies to improve language, cognition and memory.
Employ those techniques during instruction to improve development of sensory and perceptual motor skills.

tasks.design: She chooses special educational strategies for language, cognition and memory, then employs those techniques during instruction to develop sensory and perceptual motor skills. How the student responds decides the next move, so both steps stay with her. No tool is added.
tasks.previous_blocker: The techniques depend on how the student responds during instruction.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new replaces that response. She still chooses the strategies.
tasks.still_hard: Sensory and perceptual motor work happens with the student in the room.
tasks.human_edge: She adapts the techniques while she teaches.
tasks.altitude: Her week does not change. She still chooses the strategies and teaches them in the room.

reach.task: Name strategies for sensory and perceptual motor skills.
reach.learn: Which techniques this student's plan already names.

evidence.claim: Instruction and disability strategies stay with the teacher.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: this task is the choice of strategies and the instruction that uses them. It does not cover behavior rules, student records, reports, or the educational-plan meeting.
The chosen strategies are a note she writes before the lesson. There is no structured field list and no tool to keep.
Upkeep is zero because no tool is added.
Teaching in the room is a write inside the organisation. It does not send anything outside the organisation.
unknowns: Which sensory and perceptual motor techniques this student can already use.
research_questions: Which techniques does this student's plan already name for language, cognition and memory?

incremental.description: No tool is added, so there is no upkeep.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Choosing the strategies and teaching them stay as they are. A week of the same instruction still takes the full time, because no tool is added.

role.altitude: She still sets behavior rules, teaches the strategies, and meets parents about the plan. On reports she stops retyping four stored fields and still checks the draft before it is filed.
reach: The instructional coordinator names the activity fields a report must contain.
skills_to_grow: Which of pupil, activity, mark and date the pupil administration already stores.
role.ambitious_version: The required report is the stored fields, checked by her, then filed. She still keeps order, teaches, and develops the plan with the parents.
